title: Breakfast in Bed Board
h1: Breakfast in Bed Board for Two
seo_title: Breakfast in Bed Board for Two: Croissants, Brie & Berries
description: A breakfast in bed board for two: brie, Gruyère, prosciutto and ham, mini croissants, strawberries, blueberries, Greek yogurt and granola, with coffee and juice.
hook: A tray, two coffees and nowhere to be: a French-café breakfast built on one board.
why: This is a breakfast tray more than a cheese board. Mini croissants with brie or Gruyère and thin ham or prosciutto make little breakfast sandwiches, and butter and jam are there for anyone who just wants a warm croissant.
Greek yogurt, granola and berries make it filling without making it heavy, and honey ties the sweet and savory sides together. It's sized as a light breakfast for two, with coffee and orange juice.

timeline.what: Wash the berries; set out the tray and mugs.
Start the coffee; take out the cheeses.
Warm the croissants at 350°F for 5 minutes.

faq.q: What goes on a breakfast board?
faq.a: Mini croissants, a soft cheese and a firm one, thin ham or prosciutto, butter and jam, Greek yogurt, granola, berries and honey.
Yes. Five minutes in a 350°F oven makes store-bought croissants taste fresh. Add the cheese after so it doesn't melt onto the tray.

faq.q: Can I prep it the night before?
faq.a: Wash the berries and portion the yogurt and granola the night before. Build the tray in the morning, about 10 minutes.
